evidence: Changes orphan transaction storage and download management in src/node/txorphanage.cpp and src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp to fix memory accounting.
rationale: Prevents memory exhaustion attacks where peers bypass orphan memory caps by up to 28x using witness-heavy transactions that consume hundreds of megabytes of heap memory. Attackers can currently send standard-weight orphans with many 1-byte witness elements that exhaust node memory and waste significant CPU during lookup evaluation.
